<solution_file path="src/t02_load_eurostat.py">
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path

# Define input and output file paths
input_indicators = Path('outputs/t01_selected_indicators.csv')
input_api_config = Path('inputs/eurostat/sample_api_config.json')
input_eurostat_data = Path('inputs/eurostat/eurostat_city_values_sample.csv')
output_eurostat_raw = Path('outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv')

# Load selected indicators
selected_indicators = pd.read_csv(input_indicators)

# Load Eurostat data
eurostat_data = pd.read_csv(input_eurostat_data)

# Filter data by selected indicators
filtered_data = eurostat_data.merge(selected_indicators, how='inner', on=['indicator_id', 'indicator_name'])

# Group data by city_id, year, and indicator_id
grouped_data = filtered_data.groupby(['city_id', 'year', 'indicator_id']).agg({'value': 'first'})

# Reset index to get desired column order
grouped_data = grouped_data.reset_index()

# Rename columns to match output requirements
grouped_data = grouped_data.rename(columns={'value': 'value', 'indicator_id': 'indicator_id', 'indicator_name': 'indicator_name'})

# Ensure unit column is included
grouped_data['unit'] = eurostat_data['unit'].drop_duplicates().values

# Write output to CSV
grouped_data.to_csv(output_eurostat_raw, index=False)
</solution_file>
